concept: 翡翠绿圆角底，白色折叠模块组成抽象 W，呼应个人工作台与任务汇聚。
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: a finished Windows desktop application icon for a Chinese personal developer workbench, used in the Windows taskbar, desktop shortcut and the app sidebar.
Primary request: Design ONE distinctive, beautifully balanced application icon that expresses several daily tools and tasks converging into one calm personal workbench. The existing application combines notes, task capture, project launching, code review and build delivery.
Subject: a single bold ivory geometric emblem, an original abstract W subtly constructed like two modular panels joining into one sturdy work surface. Make it feel like a thoughtful custom brand mark, with a memorable continuous silhouette and carefully proportioned open negative space. Do not draw literal tools or a detailed desk.
Style/medium: refined minimal app icon with crisp vector-like geometry, softened corners and very subtle material depth; restrained professional desktop software aesthetic.
Color palette: match the existing interface's jade green primary #1A7D64, deeper evergreen #0D4034 and warm near-white #F9FBFC. A restrained tonal jade gradient is acceptable on the tile. The emblem is solid ivory, high contrast.
Composition/framing: square 1024x1024 canvas, exactly one large centered rounded-square jade tile occupying about 90% of the canvas with transparent corners outside the tile; emblem occupies about 62% of the tile, optically centered. Front view, no perspective. Clean generous internal spacing. Bold enough to read at 16, 24 and 32 pixels.
Constraints: output ONLY the finished single icon image. The outer area around the rounded-square tile must be genuinely transparent, no white canvas. No typography, labels, letters as text, captions, watermark, mockup, presentation board, extra variants, thin strokes, tiny details, badges, checkmarks, stars, sparkles, glow, glass transparency or heavy drop shadow. Use the abstract W only as a visual emblem, not as printed type.

files.purpose: Title bar and favicon PNG export
Windows app, notification and installer icon export

exportMethod: PNG resized with System.Drawing HighQualityBicubic, preserved alpha, packed into a nine-frame ICO with PNG frames. Original assets/workbench.ico and assets/workbench.svg retained.

validation.ico: All nine ICO directory entries and RGBA PNG frames validated
validation.native: Electron nativeImage loads ICO successfully at 256x256
validation.ui: Actual Electron startup with isolated data: title bar image loaded at 64x64, displayed at 24x24, favicon resolved, no page errors
validation.rollout: Source and packaging configuration updated; existing installed app and release installer were not replaced.
